devdoc.details: Pure type definitions only: no storage, no functions, no external      calls. Imported by every contract so all modules agree on layout.
devdoc.title: InsuranceTypes

userdoc.notice: Minimal, shared struct definitions for the Driver Insurance         protocol. Only the fields strictly required for trustless         on-chain insurance logic live here — everything else (trip         history, AI inputs, documents, telemetry, driver profiles) is         intentionally kept off-chain in the backend, per project scope.
